name: migrate
description: Replace an existing system layer by layer until the new application is complete. Extends /setup, run once at start.

steps.name: Prerequisites and scope protection
steps.instruction: Verify /setup has been run (SCOPE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CLAUDE.md exist). Read scope docs and endpoint registries. Migration is not an excuse to cut source system features. All source features are IN unless explicitly cut with reason and owner recorded. If parity verification system exists (entity registries, endpoint maps), read it as authoritative scope.
checklist: /setup has been run (SCOPE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CLAUDE.md exist)
Scope protection acknowledged: all source features IN unless explicitly cut

steps.name: Phase dispatch
steps.instruction: Read Active Workflow from CLAUDE.md to determine current phase. Route to the appropriate phase file. 7 phases: (1) docs sprint, (2) vertical slice, (3) horizontal buildout, (4) integration, (5) functional validation, (6) design pass, (7) cutover. Each phase file lives at phases/{NN}-{name}.md. If no workflow record: start at phase 1 and write the workflow record.
checklist: Current phase identified from Active Workflow

steps.name: Wrapup and phase advance
steps.instruction: At phase boundaries: suggest /wrapup to resolve concerns and cascade docs. Evaluate gate criteria from the current phase file. If gate passes: advance phase in CLAUDE.md Active Workflow record, announce next phase. If gate fails: list unmet criteria, propose work to close gaps. At final phase (cutover): mark workflow as completed with date.

tone: Methodical. Every feature in the source system is accounted for.
